name: strung-reference-pool
purpose: A pool of real-world beaded jewellery references for Strung to draw variety from. It is descriptive, not prescriptive: it records what these pieces are, so designs can be sampled against a wider range than any one aesthetic. It does NOT define or narrow Strung's style, and must never be used as a style constraint.
tagged_from: the board images themselves; the source JSON supplied pin ids, urls, titles and sites only
caveats: Source keyword tags were treated as unreliable and were not used; every tag here comes from the image.
Material names are visual guesses. confidence is "uncertain" on 232 of 315 material entries; read `alternatives` as equally plausible and never present a material as fact.
metal_confidence is "uncertain" on 126 of 149 records. Gold-fill, gold plate and vermeil cannot be told apart from a photograph; neither can brass from bronze, nor sterling from plated silver.
No measurement was taken. dimensions.range_mm is null unless a hand or finger gave a scale reference, and where present it is a rough estimate flagged with estimated: true.
Several flat-lay crops cannot be resolved into bracelet vs necklace; those carry piece_type "unknown" or a low tag_confidence.
tag_confidence is "low" on 15 records, mostly low-resolution or multi-piece source images.

strung_style_affinity maps a reference onto the four styles the app already ships. It is a lookup convenience; many references sit outside all four and the nearest match is recorded, not a claim that the reference belongs there.
